short_description: Files that map minified or compiled code back to the original source for debugging.

name: Hot Module Replacement
short_description: Swapping changed modules into a running app without a full reload.

name: Debouncing
short_description: Waiting until events stop firing before running a handler.

name: Throttling
short_description: Running a handler at most once per time window.

name: Isomorphic JavaScript
short_description: JavaScript that runs on both server and client, as in server rendering with hydration.

name: Event Bubbling
short_description: DOM events travelling from the target element up through its ancestors.

name: Optimistic UI
short_description: Showing the result of an action before the server confirms it.

name: Infinite Scroll
short_description: Loading more content automatically as the user scrolls down.

name: Skeleton Screens
short_description: Grey placeholder shapes shown while content loads.

name: Dark Mode
short_description: A colour scheme with light text on a dark background.

name: Floating-Point Arithmetic
short_description: Representing real numbers approximately with a significand and exponent, as in IEEE 754.

name: Two's Complement
short_description: The standard way computers represent signed integers in binary.

name: Bit Manipulation
short_description: Working directly with the bits of a value using AND, OR, XOR and shifts.

name: Topological Sorting
short_description: Ordering a directed acyclic graph so every edge points forward.

name: Union-Find
short_description: A data structure that tracks which elements belong to the same set.

name: Segment Tree
short_description: A tree for fast range queries and updates over an array.

name: Fenwick Tree
short_description: A compact tree for prefix sums with logarithmic updates.

name: AVL Tree
short_description: The first self-balancing binary search tree, kept balanced by rotations.

name: Bitmap Index
short_description: An index that stores one bit array per value, efficient for low-cardinality columns.

name: Rope
short_description: A tree of string pieces that makes edits to long text cheap, used in text editors.

name: Ring Buffer
short_description: A fixed-size buffer that wraps around, common in streaming and I/O.

name: Cuckoo Filter
short_description: A probabilistic set membership structure like a Bloom filter that also supports deletion.

name: HyperLogLog
short_description: A probabilistic algorithm that estimates how many distinct items a stream has using little memory.

name: Count-Min Sketch
short_description: A probabilistic table that estimates how often items appear in a stream.

name: Reservoir Sampling
short_description: Picking a uniform random sample from a stream of unknown length.

name: MinHash
short_description: A technique for quickly estimating how similar two sets are.

name: Locality-Sensitive Hashing
short_description: Hashing similar items into the same buckets to find near neighbours quickly.

name: Geohash
short_description: Encoding latitude and longitude as a short string whose prefixes are nearby areas.

name: Quadtree
short_description: A tree that recursively splits 2D space into four quadrants.

name: R-tree
short_description: A tree index for spatial data that groups nearby rectangles.

name: k-d Tree
short_description: A binary tree that partitions points in k-dimensional space for nearest-neighbour search.

name: Octree
short_description: A tree that recursively splits 3D space into eight octants, used in graphics and games.
